protocol_name: MSTT_RUL XJTU Batch-4/5/6 preregistered external confirmation

prior_exposure.note: Batch-2 has been repeatedly analysed and is development evidence, not an untouched external test set.

Batch-4.capacity_observation: reference capacity measured after every operating cycle

Batch-5.capacity_observation: reference capacity measured intermittently, approximately once per 11 operating cycles after cycle 20
Batch-5.analysis_scale: physical operating cycle with causal last-observation-carried-forward model input

Batch-6.capacity_observation: reference capacity measured approximately every 5 operating cycles
Batch-6.analysis_scale: physical operating cycle with causal last-observation-carried-forward model input

task.future_capacity_metric_support: only genuinely observed reference-capacity points after the cutoff and no later than the first observed EOL upper bound
task.sparse_input_fill: causal last observation carried forward; no future interpolation
task.sparse_eol_semantics: interval censored between the previous reference-capacity observation plus one cycle and the first observed crossing cycle
task.no_crossing_semantics: truth is right censored at the final genuine reference-capacity observation; a forecast without a crossing is prediction-censored at cutoff plus 700 cycles

training.scaler_fit: training cells only; capacity channel restored to physical Ah
training.common_support_gate: all MSTT arms must have identical cell and target-cycle support before training results are accepted

seed_aggregation.method: arithmetic mean of predicted capacity at each forecast cycle

uncertainty.calibration_cells: all 16 Batch-1 plus Batch-3 development cells through deterministic four-fold cell-level cross-fitting
uncertainty.nested_selection: within each outer fold, select epochs using the remaining Batch-1 cells for fitting and remaining Batch-3 cells for validation, then refit on all remaining cells
uncertainty.score: per-cell maximum absolute recursive capacity error over all eligible frozen cutoffs and observed future support
uncertainty.quantile_rule: ceil((n+1)*(1-alpha)) order statistic, clipped to n
uncertainty.claim_limit: diagnostic simultaneous capacity-trajectory band; not a distribution-free event-time survival interval

primary_family.multiplicity: Holm across the six listed comparisons

failure_rules.right_censored_external_cells: retain and score with one-sided censor-compatible timing; never drop solely because no fixed 1.6-Ah crossing is observed
